# Base Link

> A secure, military-verified rideshare platform built exclusively for
> service members and their dependents, connecting the military community
> with safe, reliable transportation between installations.

Base Link verifies riders and drivers through ID.me before they can join,
then connects them for base-to-base and nearby rides within the military
community.

## Key pages

- [Join](https://baselink.app/join): Overview of Base Link and the
  waitlist signup.
- [Log in](https://baselink.app/login): Sign in to an existing account.
- [Register](https://baselink.app/register): Create a new account.

## Technical implementation

- **Framework:** Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Auth:** ID.me verification + Firebase Authentication
- **Database:** Firebase Firestore
- **Maps:** Google Maps Platform

Source and full documentation: https://github.com/Younique98/military-rideshare
